summary.business_type: Web development studio / freelance developer portfolio (Los Angeles, CA; tourism & hospitality SMB focus)
top_findings: No prerendering — every route returns the identical 11,856-byte HTML with the homepage title and canonical; all 7 sitemap URLs self-canonicalize to the homepage
Soft 404s across the entire URL space — the Vercel blanket rewrite plus the client-side catch-all return HTTP 200 for any path
/invoices/* and /proposals/* client documents are fully crawlable — no robots.txt Disallow, no noindex, 200 on every slug
www.urawake.dev is hard-broken — TLS certificate SAN mismatch, not an unredirected variant
The tourstodo-website case study ships placeholder draft copy on a live indexable route
quick_wins: Add Disallow: /invoices/ and /proposals/ to robots.txt (2 min)
Add www.urawake.dev in Vercel with redirect-to-apex to provision the cert (5 min)
Regenerate sitemap.xml with the 4 missing routes and real lastmod values (15 min)
Point homepage ItemList schema at own /projects and /case-studies URLs instead of the generic GitHub profile (15 min)
Link case studies directly from the homepage project grid — they are currently near-orphans (30 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All security headers present and correct — CSP, HSTS with preload, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
HTTP to HTTPS 308 redirect works; trailing-slash handling consistent
Hashed /assets/* served with immutable long-lived caching
robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot and references the sitemap
Useful <noscript> fallback exists on the homepage

findings.title: Soft 404s on every URL
findings.description: /invoices/test-slug, /proposals/test-slug, and arbitrary nonexistent paths all return 200 with the identical homepage HTML. The <Navigate to="/" replace /> catch-all in App.jsx:86 only fires after JS executes.
findings.recommendation: Ship prerendering, then configure Vercel to serve a real 404 for unmatched paths.

findings.title: Private client routes are crawlable
findings.description: public/robots.txt has no Disallow for /invoices/ or /proposals/, no route sets noindex, and each returns 200. Real client content renders once JS runs.
findings.recommendation: Add robots.txt Disallow entries plus a noindex meta tag on those routes.

findings.title: No prerendering — one set of metadata for the whole site
findings.description: Every route shares one <title>, one canonical (https://urawake.dev/), one meta description and one set of OG tags in raw HTML. Expect 'Duplicate, Google chose a different canonical' in Search Console.
findings.recommendation: Add vite-react-ssg, which works with the existing react-router v7 setup.

findings.title: www subdomain TLS failure
findings.description: curl -v returns exit 60 — certificate is CN=urawake.dev with no www SAN. Visitors typing www. get a browser security error, not a redirect.
findings.recommendation: Add www.urawake.dev in Vercel domain settings with redirect-to-apex.

findings.title: Fonts shipped as raw TTF and not preloaded
findings.description: Inter variable 874KB + 904KB, Archivo Black 89KB. Only logo.png is preloaded.
findings.recommendation: Subset to WOFF2 and preload the fonts used above the fold.

findings.title: No route-level code splitting
findings.description: All route components are statically imported in App.jsx, producing a single 308KB bundle.
findings.recommendation: Wrap route components in React.lazy().

findings.title: No IndexNow integration
findings.description: No IndexNow key or submission for Bing/Yandex, which feeds Microsoft Copilot citations.
findings.recommendation: Add an IndexNow key file and ping on deploy.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Four real case studies added since June, carrying concrete quotable outcomes (100+ bookings, ~20 hrs/month automated, 130+ waivers digitized)
Clean problem/solution/outcome heading structure in case studies
llms.txt is well written and clearly structured
Bio states specialty, location, and target client unambiguously

findings.title: Placeholder case study is live
findings.description: src/data/casestudies.js:105-140 contains draft copy with no real outcome numbers, published on the indexable /case-studies/tourstodo-website route.
findings.recommendation: Finish the copy with real outcomes or remove the route until it is ready.

findings.title: Zero testimonials or third-party validation
findings.description: No client quotes, reviews, or attributed statements anywhere in the codebase. Trustworthiness carries roughly 30% of E-E-A-T weight.
findings.recommendation: Collect and publish 2-3 named client testimonials with company attribution.

findings.title: /projects/:slug pages are thin and duplicative
findings.description: Roughly 40-80 words each, largely restating the linked case study.
findings.recommendation: Either expand them into distinct content or canonicalize them to the case study.

findings.title: /why-us and /team are thin
findings.description: Approximately 200-250 and 220 words respectively, for pages carrying the commercial-intent and trust load, with no case-study links or proof points.
findings.recommendation: Expand /why-us to 700-900 words with target keywords; add proof points and internal links to /team.

findings.title: Founder bio leads with tenure
findings.description: 'Started building in late 2025' is honest but an Expertise headwind.
findings.recommendation: Reframe around output — 389 commits, 32 data models, 8 integrations — rather than years.

findings.title: Commercial keywords absent from /why-us
findings.description: The LA full-stack studio for tourism/hospitality SMBs framing is well hit in llms.txt but nearly absent from the page most likely to carry commercial intent.
findings.recommendation: Work the target phrases into /why-us headings and body copy.

findings.title: No explicit publish/modified dates on case studies
findings.description: dateCreated is derived by regex from the free-text duration field, which breaks for entries like tourstodopr ('In progress, CRM in production').
findings.recommendation: Add explicit ISO datePublished and dateModified fields to the case-study data.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: CaseStudyPage.jsx:33-88 is a model implementation — title, description, canonical, OG, Twitter, and JSON-LD with proper cleanup on unmount
Homepage title and meta description are well targeted and within length limits
lang="en" set, viewport correct, full favicon set present

findings.title: /why-us and /team set no metadata at all
findings.description: Both routes inherit and keep the homepage canonical pointing at /, effectively declaring themselves to be the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add title, description, canonical, and OG tags following the CaseStudyPage pattern.

findings.title: /projects/:slug sets only document.title
findings.description: ProjectPage.jsx:17 sets the title but no description, canonical, OG, or schema.
findings.recommendation: Extend to full metadata coverage.

findings.title: Case studies are near-orphan pages
findings.description: The only internal links come from ProjectViewer.jsx:89 and ProjectPage.jsx:116, both behind a click into a project. Nothing on the homepage links to them directly.
findings.recommendation: Link case studies from the homepage project grid and the navbar.

findings.title: Homepage h1 has no accessible name
findings.description: GlitchTitle splits the text into per-letter spans that are all aria-hidden="true". Text remains in the DOM for crawlers but screen readers get nothing.
findings.recommendation: Add a visually-hidden text node carrying the full heading.

findings.title: /team has no h1
findings.description: AboutSection renders only h2 elements.
findings.recommendation: Promote the page heading to h1 on the /team route.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Four well-constructed JSON-LD blocks in index.html — ProfilePage/Person, WebSite, ProfessionalService with OfferCatalog, and a 6-item ItemList
@id graph references between Person, WebSite, and ProfessionalService are consistent
sameAs links to LinkedIn and GitHub present
Case-study CreativeWork schema is structurally valid

findings.title: Case-study JSON-LD is client-injected only
findings.description: CaseStudyPage.jsx:60-74 injects the CreativeWork block in a useEffect. Unreliable for Google's delayed second-wave rendering and invisible to Bing, social scrapers, and AI crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Emit it in the prerendered HTML.

findings.title: ItemList URLs point off-site
findings.description: 5 of 6 CreativeWork items in index.html set url to the same generic https://github.com/danielsangronis1386 rather than the site's own pages.
findings.recommendation: Point each item at its /projects/* or /case-studies/* URL.

findings.title: Sitemap missing 4 live routes
findings.description: /why-us, /team, /projects/tourstodo-pr, and /case-studies/tourstodo-website all exist in App.jsx and the data files but are absent from public/sitemap.xml. Note that /case-studies/tourstodopr without the hyphen is correct and matches the slug in casestudies.js.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the sitemap from the route and slug definitions.

findings.title: Fabricated dateCreated fallback
findings.description: CaseStudyPage.jsx:69 falls back to the literal string "2026", which is not valid ISO 8601 and is not tied to a real date.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit ISO dates to the case-study data and drop the regex derivation.

findings.title: Stale, uniform lastmod
findings.description: Every sitemap URL carries lastmod 2026-06-22, 49 days old and identical — a low-trust freshness signal.
findings.recommendation: Emit real per-URL lastmod values at build time.

findings.title: Three orphaned ItemList entries
findings.description: ClientFlow, Fitness Tracker, and RollingLog have no corresponding route in projects.js or casestudies.js.
findings.recommendation: Remove them from the schema or build the pages.

findings.title: ProfessionalService has no logo or image
findings.description: Blocks Organization logo rich-result and Knowledge Panel eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add a logo property pointing at a square brand image.

findings.title: Injected CreativeWork.author restates the Person entity
findings.description: Uses a bare Person object instead of @id-referencing the homepage #daniel-sangronis node, splitting the entity.
findings.recommendation: Reference by @id.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList
findings.description: Project and case-study pages carry no breadcrumb markup.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList to both page types.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: TBT 0ms on both tested pages — excellent interactivity headroom
CLS 0.000 on both tested pages — no layout shift
TTFB is only ~12% of the LCP budget; the server is not the bottleneck
Hashed assets with immutable caching

findings.title: LCP 5.1s on home, 5.0s on case study — Poor
findings.description: 88% of LCP time (4.3-4.4s) is Render Delay: JS download, parse, hydrate, then the typewriter animation completing before the largest content paints.
findings.recommendation: Prerender so real hero text paints before hydration.

findings.title: Boot-splash does not help LCP
findings.description: Lighthouse identifies the LCP element as span.hero-typed on home and a body paragraph on the case study — not the preloaded /logo.png. React unmounts #boot-splash on hydrate, so the logo is never an eligible LCP candidate.
findings.recommendation: Stop treating the splash as an LCP strategy; make real content paint early instead.

findings.title: Typewriter effect gates the LCP element
findings.description: The hero eyebrow text is the LCP candidate and does not finish painting until the animation completes.
findings.recommendation: Paint the final text immediately and animate as an enhancement, or move the effect off the LCP element.

findings.title: Single 308KB JS bundle
findings.description: No route-level code splitting increases pre-hydration parse cost on every page.
findings.recommendation: Introduce React.lazy() per route.

findings.title: Lab data only
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights hit its 240 QPM rate limit; results are from local Lighthouse CLI with simulated mobile throttling rather than CrUX field data.
findings.recommendation: Re-run PageSpeed for field data once prerendering ships.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and OAI-SearchBot
llms.txt exists and is well formatted — most sites still lack one
Entity naming is perfectly consistent across index.html JSON-LD, llms.txt, and casestudies.js
sameAs links to LinkedIn and GitHub present
Case-study copy already contains concrete, reusable statistics that are citation-ready once reachable

findings.title: AI crawlers can see almost nothing
findings.description: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot do not execute JavaScript. Every route returns the same generic <noscript> block — one H1, one paragraph, a services list, one line per project. The entire case-study narrative in src/data/casestudies.js is unreachable.
findings.recommendation: Prerender every route so the case-study prose is present in raw HTML.

findings.title: llms.txt is stale and incomplete
findings.description: Links to client sites and GitHub instead of own /case-studies/* pages, describes an outdated 6-project model rather than the 4 real slugs, omits /why-us and /team, and has no last-updated date.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite against the current route and slug inventory and add a date.

findings.title: Prose is not structured for passage-level citation
findings.description: Case studies are paragraph-heavy rather than broken into self-contained 130-170 word direct-answer blocks, and headings are declarative rather than question-shaped.
findings.recommendation: Restructure into question-headed answer blocks.

findings.title: No multi-modal or community brand signals
findings.description: No YouTube content and no evident Reddit presence — the two highest-correlation off-site AI citation signals.
findings.recommendation: Build presence on at least one.

categories.name: Images
what_works: OG image is now a correct 1200x630 PNG with width, height, type, and alt declared — the June critical is resolved
Full favicon set present including apple-touch-icon and SVG
Footer textures already shipped as WebP

findings.title: Large unoptimized PNGs in build output
findings.description: Build output contains PNGs up to 917KB with no WebP or AVIF variants.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF with PNG fallback.

findings.title: 46.6MB of unused textures inside src/
findings.description: src/assets/textures/ holds 11 PNGs totaling roughly 46.6MB. Confirmed unused by grep and not currently bundled, but a live footgun if anyone imports one.
findings.recommendation: Delete them or move them outside src/.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add Disallow: /invoices/ and /proposals/ to public/robots.txt (2 min)
Add noindex meta on the invoice and proposal routes (20 min)
Add www.urawake.dev in Vercel with redirect-to-apex to fix the TLS SAN failure (5 min)
Finish or unpublish the tourstodo-website placeholder case study (30 min)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add vite-react-ssg prerendering for all static routes — resolves soft 404s, per-route canonicals and OG, client-injected schema, AI-crawler blindness, and LCP in one change (4-6 hr)
Configure Vercel to return real 404s for unmatched paths once prerendered HTML exists (30 min)
Add full metadata to /why-us, /team, and /projects/:slug following the CaseStudyPage pattern (1 hr)
Regenerate sitemap.xml with the 4 missing routes and real per-URL lastmod (20 min)
Fix ItemList schema URLs, drop the 3 orphaned entries, add logo to ProfessionalService (30 min)
Replace the "2026" dateCreated fallback with real ISO dates (30 min)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Collect and publish 2-3 named client testimonials — the single biggest E-E-A-T gap
Link case studies directly from the homepage project grid (1 hr)
Expand /why-us to 700-900 words with commercial-intent keywords; expand /team with proof points (3 hr)
Resolve /projects/:slug vs /case-studies/:slug duplication (2 hr)
Rewrite llms.txt against the current route inventory with a last-updated date (45 min)
Restructure case-study prose into question-headed 130-170 word answer blocks (3 hr)
Add BreadcrumbList schema to project and case-study pages (45 min)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Performance pass: route-level React.lazy(), WOFF2 font subsetting with preload, WebP/AVIF for the >900KB PNGs
Delete or relocate src/assets/textures/ (11 PNGs, ~46.6MB, unused)
Give the homepage h1 an accessible name and add an h1 to /team
Re-run PageSpeed for CrUX field data once prerendering ships
Submit the corrected sitemap in Search Console and watch for duplicate-canonical warnings to clear
Add IndexNow for Bing and Copilot
Build off-site AI-citation signals on YouTube and Reddit
